description:
Daily OHLCV price history for a stock.
- days: number of trading days to return (default 90). Guest/free: max 365.
  Pro: full history, up to 20,000 trading days (most established names go back
  decades; a full pull can be ~10,000+ bars, so request only what you need).
- Returns: { symbol, days_requested, days_returned, count, history[],
  history_available: { bars, earliest_date } } -
  days_returned/count can be less than days_requested if less history exists.
  When a guest/free caller asks for more than 365 days the response is capped
  at 365 and carries a `pro_unlocks` note saying what Pro adds.
- Per bar: date, open, high, low, close, volume

days.description: Number of trading days of daily OHLCV history to return (default 90). Max 365 for guest and free; Pro can request the full history (up to 20,000 trading days). A full-history call can be ~10,000+ bars - prefer a narrower window unless you need it all. days_returned/count in the response can be less than this if less history exists.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol. Also accepts a company name as a fallback when it uniquely resolves to one symbol.

name: get_stock_history
title: Get Stock Price History
